examples: div.d-flex — "Real region looks like a card (Language selection card for the Indian Space Research Organisation website, offering Hindi and English options.); rendered as footer (A cropped section of a footer with links to ISRO portals and programs.)."

div.chefs — "Real region looks like a carousel (A carousel of images showing the launch of a rocket, from preparation to liftoff.); rendered as tile (A cropped section of a web page showing mission details for various space missions, including GSLV-F17/EOS-05, PSLV-C62/EOS-N1, LVM3-M6/BlueBird Block-2, and LVM3-M5/CMS-03.)."

div.specials — "Real region looks like a banner (A banner displaying news and highlights related to ISRO's activities, including a call for registration and a celebration of National Space Day.); the rendered region is blank."

header.d-flex — "Real region looks like a footer (A cropped section of a footer with navigation links and social media icons.); rendered as header (A cropped section of a header with navigation links and a logo for 'ISRO DOS Banner'.)."
